top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori, Ye) are a mature, independently reproduced achievement: magic-wavelength trapping of neutral atoms brought optical frequency standards to the 1e-18 level, and the two-name allocation with a citation limited to invention and realisation is clean. Twisted bilayer graphene (P002) is excellent science but is weaker on attribution (first author Yuan Cao cannot be named under the three-person limit) and the superconductivity mechanism remains open; it ranks second, above no award.
